title: CHORDS (keyboard chord modes)
author: stephen
description: The Digitone II's chord modes for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys, on the TRIG key's second page, Chords, drawn after the Digitone II's keyboard setup screen: a keyboard with the last chord and the CENTER arrow (knob A), BASS OCT (D), MODE (E: OFF, CHORD ROOT, CENTER, SPREAD), the track's keyboard ROOT (F) and SCALE (G), and SHAPE (H; the Digitone II's 8 shapes in a scale, TRIG 1-8 too, and its 12 types on chromatic). With MODE on, each single-note trig on the track plays that chord from ROOT and SCALE; trigs that hold a chord play as stored. The sequencer's trigs only for now, not the TRIG keys played live. Needs core-dn1 3.3 and seq-events.
